label.en: Interpreter language foundations and shared professional practice

jurisdiction.region: General interpreter practice; specific legal/clinical rules labeled by source

label.en: Professional roles, ethics and accountable boundaries

translationAreas.description: Important. Distinguish interpreting, translation, mediation and other roles; research accuracy, impartiality, confidentiality, conflicts and scope. Evidence responsibility: compare explicitly bounded professional standards and show transparent responses to role pressure without inventing universal duties. Sources: professional associations and institutional codes. Queries: 'interpreter translator mediator role professional code ethics'; 'medical legal interpreter accuracy confidentiality impartiality standards'.

label.en: Consecutive, simultaneous, sight and remote workflows

translationAreas.description: Important. Map preparation, turn management, reception, processing, delivery, monitoring and closure across modes. Evidence responsibility: source-grounded mode distinctions, suitable workflow considerations and limitations, including document and remote constraints; avoid unsupported performance promises. Sources: professional practice guides and original interpreting research. Queries: 'professional interpreting consecutive simultaneous sight translation remote guidance'; 'interpreting modes turn management original research'.

label.en: Listening, discourse structure and meaning units

translationAreas.description: Important. Research discourse organization, reference, cohesion, topic shifts, meaning units, propositional content and pragmatic force. Evidence responsibility: contextual analyses showing which relations and speaker commitments must survive transfer; separate analytic teaching models from proven cognitive mechanisms. Sources: primary discourse/pragmatics research and professional resources. Queries: 'interpreting discourse cohesion reference meaning units research'; 'pragmatic force propositional content interpreting research'.

Critical. Cover scope, qualification, possibility, obligation, permission, hypothetical conditions and reported certainty. Evidence responsibility: source-grounded English–Spanish and English–Chinese contrastive analyses with contextual examples preserving strength, scope and speaker commitment; mark ambiguous readings and repair options. Sources: authoritative grammars and primary linguistic research. Queries: 'English Spanish negation modality conditional scope grammar'; 'English Chinese negation modality uncertainty contrastive research'.

Critical. Research chronology, completion, repetition, duration, causation, agent/patient roles and direct/reported speech. Evidence responsibility: contextual contrastive dossiers preserving who did or reported what, when and with what temporal status; distinguish linguistic form from inferred factual meaning. Sources: authoritative language references and original contrastive studies. Queries: 'English Spanish tense aspect reported speech agency'; 'English Chinese aspect time reference reported speech grammar'.

label.en: Register, politeness, idiom and sensitive speech

translationAreas.description: Important. Cover formal/informal register, indirectness, politeness, euphemism, idiom, taboo, profanity and disfluency. Evidence responsibility: context-dependent meaning and stance analyses that avoid sanitizing, intensifying or stereotyping speech; investigate multiple defensible renderings and their limits. Sources: pragmatics research, contextual language references and interpreter standards. Queries: 'Spanish Chinese English register politeness euphemism interpreting research'; 'interpreting profanity disfluency professional accuracy'.

Important. Investigate regional/dialect variation, Chinese spoken varieties and scripts, Spanish regional usage and concepts without direct institutional counterparts. Evidence responsibility: explicitly bounded variant records and source-supported explanations; distinguish language choice, identity and literacy without predicting them from nationality. Sources: authoritative regional language references and originating institutions. Queries: 'Spanish regional terminology authoritative language reference'; 'Chinese language varieties simplified traditional script professional interpreting'; '[institution] official multilingual explanation'.

label.en: Transparent clarification, correction and communication repair

translationAreas.description: Critical. Cover ambiguity, unfamiliar terminology, inaudibility, overlapping turns, interpreter errors and requests to simplify. Evidence responsibility: standards-grounded intervention boundaries and labeled repair sequences preserving speaker ownership and uncertainty. Sources: professional codes, institutional protocols and interaction research. Queries: 'interpreter transparent clarification correction error professional standards'; 'interpreting repair ambiguity overlapping speech research'.

Important. Research selective notes, discourse links, names/numbers, recall, segmentation and processing demands without prescribing stenographic overload. Evidence responsibility: explain proposed techniques, evidence populations, study limits and context; distinguish pedagogical exercises from demonstrated transfer to professional performance. Sources: original interpreting studies and credible professional training references. Queries: 'consecutive interpreting note taking memory empirical study'; 'interpreting cognitive load segmentation training transfer research'.

label.en: Numbers, units, dates, names and abbreviations

translationAreas.description: Critical. Cover quantities, decimal conventions, ranges, percentages, dates, times, names, spelling, identifiers and contextual abbreviation ambiguity. Evidence responsibility: sourced convention contrasts and preservation/verification strategies; distinguish faithful transfer from unauthorized unit conversion or guessed expansion. Sources: official measurement/style references, originating documents and professional guidance. Queries: 'official units decimal date conventions Spanish Chinese'; 'interpreter numbers names spelling abbreviation accuracy guidance'.

label.en: Terminology research, source authority and uncertainty

translationAreas.description: Important. Cover identifying a concept, discovering sources, assessing authority/currentness, corroborating contextual equivalents and maintaining a personal termbase. Evidence responsibility: reproducible research trails and dossier fields linking concept, context, jurisdiction, variant, source passage, uncertainty and revision history; distinguish translation evidence from frequency alone. Sources: professional terminology standards/guidance and institutional multilingual publications. Queries: 'terminology management concept context source reliability interpreting'; 'official bilingual terminology jurisdiction variant source documentation'.

label.en: Documents, remote channels and communication access

translationAreas.description: Important. Research document layout, legibility, missing context, audio/video constraints, turn visibility, interruption and accessibility. Evidence responsibility: mode-specific preparation and failure/repair sequences grounded in institutional guidance; distinguish language variation from access or literacy needs and avoid technical/privacy guarantees. Sources: professional remote/sight guidance and official accessibility resources. Queries: 'remote interpreting audio video failure protocol professional'; 'sight translation legibility document preparation standards'; 'interpreting communication access accessibility guidance'.

Important. Supply explanatory definitions needed by both handbooks, including professional, linguistic, clinical and legal concepts, with owning-volume links. Evidence responsibility: source-linked scope, contrasts and relationships; show where identical words carry different domain meanings through labeled synthetic situations. Avoid duplicate domain chapters and unsupported equivalence tables. Sources: the two handbooks' accepted evidence plus authoritative linguistic/professional sources. Queries: '[shared concept] clinical legal meaning official'; '[linguistic concept] authoritative definition interpreting context'; '[concept] Spanish Chinese institutional terminology'.
